sentences.en: She gave a shrug of the shoulders.
With a shrug and some sorrow, Europeans bid 'Adieu' to EU member Britain.
sentences.zh: 带着一丝悲伤，欧洲人向欧盟成员国英国挥手告别。

sentences.en: In North America when a person shrugs his shoulders it means "I don't know".
sentences.zh: 在北美，当一个人耸耸肩时，意味着‘我不知道’。

senses.zh: 耸肩以表示冷淡；怀疑等
耸肩；女式短茄克衫或前开襟毛线衫
